summary: Sandbach United drew 1-1 with New Mills in an eventful match that saw them reduced to ten men for ten minutes when their number 4 received a sin bin for dissent. Despite the numerical disadvantage and late pressure from New Mills, who scored a header in the 85th minute, the Blues held firm to secure a point, with Stan making a crucial last-ditch tackle and Hall producing a brave save to keep the scores level.
